meta.name: token-efficiency
meta.description: Reduce token waste by 40-60% through anti-sycophancy rules, tool-call budgets, one-pass coding, task profiles, and read-before-write enforcement. Inspired by drona23/claude-token-efficient.

copy.tagline: 减少大语言模型交互中的令牌浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用大语言模型时经常超出令牌限制或费用过高。
copy.tagline_en: Reduce token waste in LLM interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often exceed token limits or incur high costs when using large language models.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会减少废话和重复操作，直接给出答案或代码，避免不必要的工具调用和文件重读，从而节省 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当对话感觉昂贵或缓慢、输出冗长、或 Claude 反复读取文件时触发。也适合在开始新项目时启用。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 bug，用最简洁的方式。
分析这份数据，先给结论再给细节。
say.note: Claude 会使用分析模式，先输出摘要再提供背景。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reduces verbose output and redundant operations, directly providing answers or code, avoiding unnecessary tool calls and file re-reads to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when sessions feel expensive or slow, output is verbose, or Claude re-reads files unnecessarily. Also suitable when starting a new project.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in the most concise way.
say_en.note: Claude follows one-pass coding: reads files first, then fixes once.

say_en.text: Analyze this data, lead with findings.
say_en.note: Claude uses analysis profile: summary first, details after.
